notes.title: Listeria Wars — Update 1.0.4. Cost is reduced!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36073259/4fe95408a14906071d4dc73478fe81fbbf67f6f7.png[/img]
I have come to the realization that I had initially set an excessively high price for the game. After conducting a thorough analysis, I have made adjustments to ensure that the price is in line with the current market standards.

Furthermore, several issues were identified and have been rectified.

What's new in 1.0.4?
[list]
[*] Replaced immune system cell videos by gifs due to problems with some devices and platforms
[*] Fixed bug that displayed cell video in popups while it isn't needed
[*] Optimized shaders for better performance
[*] Fixed xbox gamepad detection
[*] Fixed issues with submitting achievements after offline playing
[*] Fixed menu double clicks while clicking once
[*] Balance has been improved and fixed bug that add mana (sc) while palying intro videos
[*] Fixed bug that didn't hide cursor while using gamepad
[*] Moved to new unity version and added little improvements
[/list]

Mac/Linux versions on the way!

Thank you for your feedback and advices!
I hope I made the game better and will definitely continue to improve it.
